project_type: React 18 SPA + PHP Slim 4 Backend + Supabase (PostgreSQL)
test_framework: No frontend test framework installed yet (PHPUnit for PHP). Phase 8 requires adding Vitest + React Testing Library.
test_command: pnpm test (to be configured with Vitest)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'pnpm build' to confirm TypeScript compiles and Vite bundles successfully. 2. Run 'pnpm test' after Vitest is configured. 3. Run 'pnpm lint' to check for lint errors.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. No Supabase credentials available for runtime testing - use mock data patterns as established in existing pages.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode enforced. Use path aliases (@/). Follow existing component patterns in src/components/ui/. Use cn() utility for conditional class merging. All pages include motion animations on mount. Dark glassmorphism design system.
key_patterns: Pages use lazy loading in App.tsx with React Router. Hooks use TanStack Query with Supabase client. DataTable component for list views. PageHeader for page titles. Dialog for create/edit forms. motion/react for animations. Badge for status indicators. All Supabase queries follow pattern in useProducts.ts. Sidebar uses navSections array in Sidebar.tsx.
directory_structure: src/pages/ (route pages by module), src/components/ui/ (base UI primitives), src/components/shared/ (reusable composite components), src/components/layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, TopNav), src/hooks/ (TanStack Query hooks), src/contexts/ (AuthContext, SidebarContext), src/lib/ (utils, supabase client), src/types/ (TypeScript types), src/services/ (API services), supabase/migrations/ (SQL migrations), server/php/ (PHP Slim 4 API)
